features.description: Exact variant key count (73), range (E1-E7), white/black pattern, and geometry.
Six ordered sections at documented widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split, continuous chassis.
Stable control IDs, per-section landmarks and density, Program/Synth as the only primary OLEDs.
Pointer/touch/keyboard key press, release, and cancel/blur behavior.
Every visible control moves or presses accessibly and changes presentation state only.
Accessible names, roles, values, keyboard operation, and visible focus.
Note on/off, repeated and overlapping notes, release, all-notes-off, node cleanup.
Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped keyboard with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/sustain, and denied/disconnected MIDI.
Sustain transitions, concurrent voices, deterministic stealing, velocity response.
Truthful loading/ready/error/fallback status; blur/disconnect/unmount stops every owned voice.
No marketing hero, detached rails, missing keys, overflow, or clipped chassis at 1440x900 and 390x844.

Six selectable types; Grand/Upright/Electric are bundled recorded sample sets that load offline and render audibly distinct signals; Clav/Digital/Misc are honest synthesis; labeled playable fallback on asset failure.
Two layers (A, B) with enable, focus, level, and octave shift and correct per-layer voice ownership; disabled layers produce no voices.
KB Touch (3 curves), Dyn Comp (Off/1/2/3), Timbre, Unison (Off/1/2/3), and Soft Release each measurably change rendered audio.
Sustain from the engine API (UI/keyboard/MIDI CC64) holds released notes until the pedal lifts and only affects layers with SUSTPED on.
When sample assets fail to load the engine enters a labeled playable fallback that still renders sound (synthesized), never claiming recordings it lacks.
One AudioContext feeds layer buses, ordered effect units, master gain/limiter, and one destination; master level scales loudness; dispose cleans up all voices.
Focus follows/overrides layer focus, Piano group mode, Delay/Compressor/Reverb global mode, per-unit bypass, all-effects bypass, documented signal order, and To Rotary routing (reverb before rotary).
Each effect unit and every listed type processes real audio and is audibly distinct, with working bypass and dry/wet; delay feedback filtering processes the repeats.
The Phase 1 surface, keybed, inputs, accessibility, and console cleanliness remain intact under the Phase 2 AudioEngine.
Storing and re-loading any of the 32 slots round-trips all supported control + performance state (Master Level excluded) via JSON serialization.
8 Live slots auto-store every edit, persist across slot changes, and survive a bank export/import (reload); Store As names a program.
Editing sets the dirty (E) flag; selecting another program discards edits (edit-discard); Store clears dirty; cancel store reverts.
32 slots across 4 pages of 8 plus 8 Live slots; dial/page/program-button browsing; numeric list; >=8 factory programs demonstrating piano/organ/synth/split/layered setups.
Piano/Organ/Synth layers route through the single graph; scene enable and split zones gate whether each layer sounds; dispose tears down every section's voices.
Splits with editable points/crossfades route notes by zone; a split silences notes outside a layer's zone; crossfades fade a layer across the boundary (audible level change).
Morph assignment add/replace/clear per source (Wheel, Control Pedal); morphing the filter cutoff interpolates and is observable in rendered audio.
Layer Scenes I/II toggle enable state without changing shared sound parameters; scene I vs II select different enabled layers in audio.
B3, Vox, Farf, and Pipe render spectrally distinct signals (not one renamed oscillator); percussion, key click, and vibrato/chorus measurably change rendered audio.
Nine drawbars drive each model's audible spectrum (adding upper drawbars increases brightness; all-zero yields near silence); B3 Bass limits to 16'/8'.
Organ routes into the shared rotary (reverb before rotary) with slow/fast/stop acceleration and drive; renders real audio.
Pure, Sync, Multi, Super, and FM-H are audibly distinct source constructions; Osc Ctrl acts per category (Super detune, FM index).
LP12/LP24/HP/BP filters, cutoff, resonance, tracking, drive, and osc/filter/amp envelopes each alter rendered audio (cutoff removes highs, HP vs LP, attack delays onset, filter env sweep).
Poly stacks voices; mono/legato keep a single voice per layer; unison adds detuned voices; glide/priority/vibrato change voice behavior.
Deterministic arpeggiator/gate: arpSequence order for Up/Down/Up-Down/Range, seeded Random reproducibility, manual-scheduler tick order, and master-clock tap BPM.
Piano + Organ + Synth all render through the ONE AudioContext to one destination; no second AudioContext; dispose cleans up every section.
Every functional control maps to real audio/system state (organ/synth/program bindings + transpose shifting whole-instrument pitch); spec-excluded controls stay decorative.
All inherited Phase-1 and Phase-2 visual, piano, effects, input, and accessibility behavior remains regression-free under the Phase-3 engine.
